description: This file defines API endpoints for managing time-tracking sessions in a backend service. It includes routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting session records, utilizing FastAPI framework constructs. The file interacts with data storage through imported functions and uses Pydantic models for request and response schemas.

classes.name: SessionListResponse
classes.description: Pydantic model representing a response containing a list of session objects.

methods.name: SessionListResponse list_all_sessions( project_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by project ID"), task_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by task ID"), active: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="If true, returns only sessions without an end_time"), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list sessions with optional filters by project, task, and activity status.

methods.name: Session create_session(payload: SessionCreate)
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new session, assigning a unique ID and timestamps.

methods.name: Session get_session(session_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a session by its ID, raising 404 if not found.

methods.name: Session update_session(session_id: str, payload: SessionUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing session's details, with re-fetching to ensure computed fields are included.

methods.name: delete_session(session_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a session by its ID, raising 404 if the session does not exist.

ctags.name: items
ctags.pattern: /^    items: List[Session] = Field(..., description="List of sessions")$/

ctags.name: list_all_sessions
ctags.signature: ( project_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by project ID"), task_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by task ID"), active: Optional[bool] = Query(None, description="If true, returns only sessions without an end_time"), )
